segments.sn36.5:1.3: Sukhā vedanā, dukkhā vedanā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā.
segments.sn36.5:1.4: Sukhā, bhikkhave, vedanā dukkhato daṭṭhabbā, dukkhā vedanā sallato daṭṭhabbā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā aniccato daṭṭhabbā.
segments.sn36.5:1.5: Yato kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno sukhā vedanā dukkhato diṭṭhā hoti, dukkhā vedanā sallato diṭṭhā hoti, adukkhamasukhā vedanā aniccato diṭṭhā hoti – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave,‘bhikkhu sammaddaso acchecchi taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mānābhisamayā antamakāsi dukkhassā’”ti.
segments.sn36.5:3.3: So vedanā pariññāya, diṭṭhe dhamme anāsavo;
segments.sn36.5:3.5: Kāyassa bhedā dhammaṭṭho, saṅkhyaṃ nopeti vedagū”ti.

lines: Vipariṇāmanavasena dukkhato daṭṭhabbāti kiñcāpi sukhā, pariṇāmadukkhatā pana sukhavedanāya ekantikāti.
Svāyaṃ hutvā abhāvākāro itarāsupi vedanāsu labbhateva, adhiko ca pana dvinnaṃ dukkhasabhāvo.
Dukkhatāvasena purimānaṃ vedanānaṃ daṭṭhabbatāya dassitattā pacchimāya vedanāya evaṃ daṭṭhabbatā dassitā.
